<thought>To obtain the target 4,4'-dimethoxystilbene in a single step, a McMurry coupling of two equivalents of commercially available 4‑methoxybenzaldehyde is appropriate. This reaction converts the aldehyde C=O groups into a C=C bond, directly giving the desired stilbene. I will locate a retrosynthetic template that represents an aldehyde‑aldehyde coupling (McMurry) and then verify that 4‑methoxybenzaldehyde is buyable. Finally I will output the route in the required JSON format.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
